products.name: SharePoint Online Search & Information Architecture — Commercial
products.short_description: Tune SharePoint Online search & information architecture — managed metadata/content types, search schema + managed properties, result sources/verticals, promoted results, and Microsoft Search — so content surfaces fast. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Make SharePoint content findable with search and information architecture

If users can't find content, SharePoint fails — and search only works on a sound information architecture. This solution tunes SPO search and IA: managed metadata and site columns/content types, search schema (managed properties, mappings), result sources and verticals, promoted results, and the Microsoft Search experience — so the right content surfaces fast across the tenant.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — how SPO/Microsoft Search works: crawling, the search schema (crawled→managed properties), result sources/verticals, promoted results, and the IA that feeds it.
  • Requirements Guide — prerequisites with how to verify/implement (SPO admin/search admin, taxonomy/content-type owners, IA baseline, stakeholders).
  • Implementation Guide — establish metadata/content types, configure the search schema + managed properties, set result sources/verticals + promoted results, tune the Microsoft Search experience, and validate findability — pilot-first, each artifact named.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic SharePoint Online Management Shell / PnP PowerShell / Microsoft Graph automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
  • Validation gates (key content findable, metadata driving results, verticals working) plus Best Practices for sustained findability.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Content that's actually findable — metadata and content types in place, search schema tuned, verticals and promoted results configured — users find the right thing fast.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • Get-SearchHealthScope.ps1 — Report search & IA health/coverage across a set of sites: which carry the standard content types and
    • Get-SearchIAAssessment.ps1 — Read-only discovery of the SharePoint Online search & IA baseline: term sets, published content
    • Set-ManagedPropertyMapping.ps1 — Map crawled properties to refinable managed properties (alias + queryable/retrievable/refinable
    • Set-SearchSourceVertical.ps1 — Configure a scoped result source and record the intended vertical + promoted-result/bookmark set
    • Test-Findability.ps1 — Validate findability by running representative test queries and checking each returns its expected

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
